title: TensorPlate CLI JSON Output Envelope
description: Stable machine-readable output envelope used by `tensorplate` subcommands when `--output json` is selected. The envelope is intentionally narrow: a coarse `status`, an optional typed `error`, the active correlation/transaction id, and a command-specific `payload` whose shape is documented by each subcommand. The envelope is versioned so release validation scripts can rely on stable field names.

warnings.description: Process-level notes that are not tied to the command's result: today, a packaged CLI config that was found and not used, so a caller can tell an install running on the packaged profile from one running on the built-in defaults. Absent when there are none; never a substitute for `error`.

payload.description: Command-specific payload. See per-command docs in `docs/cli/`. Always present on `status=ok` results; absent or null on errors.

device.description: Present only when the command was routed to a registry device over SSH. Identifies the target and is omitted for local runs.
